rules: 50 MHz is entered only after card identity and CMD6 high-speed admission; otherwise the card remains at 25 MHz and cannot claim the 4-MB/s qualified profile
card busy polling releases CS between bounded polls so it cannot hold the display off for the card-internal stall
display and SD transfers are each <=1 ms; critical UI has priority, and the display average payload budget is <=1 MB/s while the qualified 4-MB/s storage profile is active

radio_service.rule: all four compatibility-radio buses are independent PIO state machines with persistent DMA; display, storage, audio, C5 and U214 cannot own or block them

s3_c5.scope: admitted waterfall/metadata/event payload, not an impossible promise to forward every raw Wi-Fi frame or RF sample

resource_rows.independence: scheduled only between display and storage; no radio/IPC/audio endpoint uses SPI2
resource_rows.deadline: critical/menu first visible response <=100 ms and qualified storage >=4.0 MB/s while all radios capture; no radio FIFO or IPC deadline is placed here

resource_rows.independence: dedicated I2S0 plus one independent GDMA TX/RX pair
resource_rows.deadline: continuous DMA audio without storage/display service gaps

resource_rows.independence: PIO0 SM0 plus two persistent DMA channels
resource_rows.deadline: IRQ serviced before nRF FIFO/transaction deadline under simultaneous peers

resource_rows.independence: PIO0 SM1 plus two persistent DMA channels
resource_rows.deadline: IRQ serviced before nRF FIFO/transaction deadline under simultaneous peers

resource_rows.independence: PIO0 SM2 plus two persistent DMA channels
resource_rows.deadline: IRQ serviced before nRF FIFO/transaction deadline under simultaneous peers

resource_rows.independence: PIO0 SM3 plus two persistent DMA channels
resource_rows.deadline: GDO/FIFO service completes without waiting for any nRF or U214 transfer

resource_rows.independence: dedicated S3 SPI3 and RP SPI1 plus their own DMA
resource_rows.deadline: 20 MHz SPI raw 2.5 MB/s and qualified framed payload >=1.5 MB/s; no display/storage or C5 controller ownership
1-bit SDIO at 20 MHz raw 2.5 MB/s with qualified framed payload >=1.5 MB/s, admitted occupancy <=70% and control RTT <=2 ms; no microSD, RP or display controller ownership

resource_rows.independence: scheduled control/status only; never transports a radio FIFO, encoder phase or PTT edge
resource_rows.deadline: ordinary UI/control first visible response <=100 ms; PD/pack/fault status is read after shared IRQ, and no radio FIFO, encoder-edge or PTT deadline is placed here

residual_physical_only: qualify SD card identity/CMD6 high-speed mode, >=4.0-MB/s storage, 1.5-MB/s record, 250-ms stalls and 512-KiB buffering
scope shared SPI2 edges, CS-high high-Z/contention and <=1-ms display/SD arbitration under insert/remove
capture all three nRF24 IRQ-to-drain paths and every 3PRX/PTX role mix at 10-Mbit/s SPI
capture CC1101 GDO/FIFO service at 600-kbit/s air rate and 10-Mbit/s SPI
run full-duplex 48-kHz audio without DMA underrun/overrun during display, storage and radio-event stress
prove S3-RP >=1.5 MB/s with <=250-us alert-to-read and S3-C5 >=1.5 MB/s with <=2-ms control RTT
measure 400-kHz SYS_I2C transaction/recovery/IRQ latency with every assembled address and simultaneous UI activity
